newsitem.title: USA: Countrywide says June fundings hit $3.3 bln.
newsitem.headline: Countrywide says June fundings hit $3.3 bln.

text.p: Countrywide Credit Industries Inc Thursday said it funded $3.3 billion of mortgage loans in June, and loans in process totaled $5.3 billion at June 30.

In a statement, the mortgage lender and servicer said its fixed-rate loan production amounted to $2.2 billion, or 68 percent of total production, in June 1997 versus $2.3 billion, or 74 percent of total production, in June 1996.
Purchase mortgage activity was $2.5 billion in June 1997 and $2.4 billion in June 1996. Refinances were 24 percent of total fundings in both June 1997 and 1996.
The company's servicing portfolio increased to $165 billion at June 30, 14 percent higher than the $146 billion portfolio at June 30, 1996.
The portfolio had a weighted average coupon of 7.8 percent at the end of both June 1997 and 1996.
